There will always be purist in any sort of medium that has a fan base (especially if it is a large series) and some purist can prove fatal a series cough cough Sonic cough cough, but I am glad that MGS community doesn't currently have a huge toxicity towards Keifer current position of taking the mantel of Big Boss. At least to my knowledge.

I feel as if Kiefer Sutherlands voice has something very "heavy" to it. I feel like when he speaks, I hear a veteran of war. His timbre and his pitch are low and rough (I find myself thinking about the "barky" tone of a baritone saxophone), not to mention his facial capture work is subtle but emotive at the same time. In contrast, David Hayter's voice, I find, is a lot more sneaky and sleazy-like but younger. He sounds like a student, in my mind, because his voice doesn't really carry the weight that Keifer has. Even in Peace Walker I felt as if Snake wasn't truly a veteran of war when he was voiced by Hayter. Phantom Pains needs a Snake that is transcending hate. We need the pure embodiment of unrelenting wrath that will give him a reason to pull the trigger and make Outer Haven a reality. Keifer has the kind of voice that can make me believe that.

Atleast that is my feeling about it all.

As long as they dont fuck with Solid Snake. Solid Snake must always be David Hayter to me. Always. Big Boss can whoever I guess, as long as it doesn't sound too different. I think some problems people have with it, is that they are picture Kiefer Sutherland instead of seeing big boss, because they recognize Kiefer's voice.
'Reserve judgement until you've played it' is pretty solid advice for any game tbh.
